neighbours.label: the compared operand in a Python identity or equality test ('if x is y', 'x == y'): the token that completes the test of whether two names are the same object

notes: 'is' tests peaked highest in probes (0.47, 0.82); 'in' was inconsistent, so it is left out of the label. The - pole also fires in code comparisons, so the two poles may split operand position rather than topic.
